summary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp., a Greek-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting outcomes of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held November 4, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of Ms. Christina Anagnostara as a Class B Director serving until the 2029 Annual Meeting, and ratified Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed; the filing is incorporated by reference into existing Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine meeting-results notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
